claims.text: POL-NS-09(d) is triggered on the face of this record: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d stands at 3 for the trailing 30 days and that limb escalates the case at 3 or more. I rely on the trailing-window counter the limb actually names — POL-GEN-01 permits rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d to be cited for POL-NS-09(d) and for nothing else — and not on the lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure on the same profile, which is a different field and is not what the limb reads. Escalation under POL-NS-09 is mandatory and terminal under POL-GEN-03: the Judge issues no monetary ruling, the disputed SGD 4.50 is placed on hold rather than collected, and the rider therefore does not carry the disputed charge while a human reviewer settles the open question. The consequence is not academic here, because SGD 4.50 sits below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05 — a merits ruling against the rider would execute against her card on issue, whereas the escalation keeps the money held.

The driver had actual notice that the rider was on her way down and did not answer her. The chat log records the rider's message 'coming down now' sent at 11:19:39 and read by the driver at 11:20:09, and before cancelling at 11:24:09 the driver neither posted a reply within 120 seconds of that message nor placed any in-app voice call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are engaged on those facts. I do not press limb (c) as satisfied, because on this record it is not: the rider's own track places her device between 697 m and 704 m from the pickup pin across 69 fixes, with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider here and I do not ask the Judge to decide the fee under it.

I do not ask for a refund under POL-NS-06, and I say so rather than dress the numbers up: the driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in a continuous run of 42 qualifying fixes running from 11:17:19 to 11:24:09, a dwell of 410 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), so there is no shortfall in seconds and the arithmetic route to a full refund is closed on this record. What the record does carry is the POL-NS-09(d) counter, and what the rider seeks is that the disputed SGD 4.50 be reviewed by a person before it is taken — not that the fee was never chargeable in the ordinary course.

claims.text: The trip record contains the driver's own 'arrived' event for this trip: at 2026-08-09T11:17:19+08:00 the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at the pickup point (event_type driver_arrived, source PLATFORM_TELEMETRY), so limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the platform's own record.

The driver was inside the arrival radius. The derived driver track puts his closest approach to the pickup pin at 0.111 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), and the derived arrival facts record 42 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in a single in-geofence run whose first fix is timestamped 11:17:19 — the same second as the recorded arrival event, with dwell_start_offset_sec of 0.0. The proximity test of POL-NS-02 is met and the in-geofence clock starts at 11:17:19, not later.

The driver held position inside the geofence for one continuous run of 410 seconds, from 11:17:19 to 11:24:09, on 42 fixes (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run). The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) and no_show_threshold_sec is null, so the limb (c) minimum is 180 seconds and the driver exceeded it by 230 seconds.

The termination satisfies limb (d). The trip record shows no boarding event and no trip start, and the trip was ended by the driver at 11:24:09 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes POL-NS-01(d) names — 230 seconds after the required 180-second dwell had elapsed at 11:20:19.

POL-NS-05 does not apply. The arrival marker is not false: the driver's closest approach to the pin is 0.111 m, and the derived arrival facts run the free-wait clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 11:17:19, the same timestamp as the marker. Nothing in the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin at the arrival timestamp, and a run of 42 consecutive in-geofence fixes spanning 410 seconds at a 10 second cadence is not a driver travelling at 15 km/h or more at the marker. No recomputation of the waiting clock is required, so the 410-second dwell stands as computed.

This is not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03. That clause opens only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here they lie inside the radius, at a closest approach of 0.111 m, so POL-NS-02 governs and no refund route opens under POL-NS-03. In any event trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity limb of POL-NS-03 has nothing to operate on.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because limb (c) is affirmatively failed. Even assuming the rider's 11:19:39 message 'coming down now' is a locating or coordinating message under limb (a) and that the driver's silence engages limb (b), the rider's own track carries 69 fixes from 11:15:33 to 11:25:48 whose closest approach to the pickup pin is 697.09 m — nearly seven times the 100 m rider-presence radius for STANDARD — and derived.arrival.rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0, so there is not one qualifying rider fix inside that radius across the waiting window. All three limbs are required; limb (c) fails on admissible fixes and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01.

POL-NS-06's refund route does not open: the effective in-geofence dwell of 410 seconds exceeds the 180-second minimum on a single uninterrupted run, so there is no shortfall — the derived shortfall is -230 seconds. The accumulation limb POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable on this record and the driver says so plainly: the traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-03306-01 is MISSING, its admissibility status is MISSING, its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT fired (no advisory covers Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd in this window); the trace also shows only one in-geofence interval, so there is no second interval to sum. The driver does not need that limb, because one continuous qualifying run already meets the minimum.

The rider's own account is contradicted by the record. The driver messaged 'hi im at the pickup point, where are you' at 11:17:44, the rider read it at 11:18:24 and answered 'coming down now' at 11:19:39, and the driver then waited a further 4 minutes 30 seconds — past the 11:20:19 expiry of the free waiting period — before terminating at 11:24:09. Throughout the window the rider's device never came closer than 697.09 m to the pickup pin, so 'I came down and the car was gone' is not consistent with the rider's own GPS track.

No integrity defect under POL-NS-08 undermines the driver's case. The chat log holds exactly the 2 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records, with the msg_id sequence intact and no gap spanning the arrival marker; the trace has 100.0% coverage at a 10 second cadence with max_gap_sec 0.0 and no sampling gap inside the waiting window; the arrival event and the first qualifying in-geofence fix share the same timestamp, i.e. 0 seconds of skew against the 90 second limb (a) threshold; and the SGD 4.50 cancellation-fee line reconciles exactly with the net fee in force, so limb (d) is not engaged.

The driver is entitled to compensation. With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60, which is the figure the fare ledger itself computes as driver_compensation. The anti-farming check trips on neither limb: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the 4-or-more limb, and 0 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (60) is 0.0, below the 0.08 rate limb. No other driver_profile field is relied on for this check.

The fee is not refunded to the rider and the ruling the case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION. The fare ledger shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so on this rider-filed dispute the disposition of the fee is NO_ACTION and the charge stands; and because POL-NS-01 is satisfied and POL-NS-07 is engaged, the outcome is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60 under POL-GEN-03.

One escalation limb is engaged and the driver states it rather than leaves it to be found: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 3, and POL-NS-09(d) is the limb that reads that trailing-30-day counter — not the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter, which POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting for it. On that limb the case routes to human review and the disputed SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded, which freezes the driver's position rather than reversing it; the driver asks that the completed POL-NS-01 findings and the SGD 3.60 POL-NS-07 entitlement travel in the escalation packet so the reviewer can release the fee and the compensation to him.

ruling.explanation:
Escalated to a human reviewer; the disputed SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is held — not collected from the rider, not released — until that review.

TRIGGER. POL-NS-09(d) requires escalation where rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 3 or more. The rider's profile (EV-RPROF-03306) shows exactly 3 no-show disputes in the trailing 30 days, so the case goes to a person, and POL-GEN-03 makes that terminal: no money moves now. POL-GEN-01 permits this field to be cited for this limb and nothing else; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure (also 3) is NOT the field the limb reads and was not used by either side.

DRIVER'S CASE, RECORDED FOR THE REVIEWER. The trip record (EV-TRIP-03306) carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 11:17:19; the GPS trace (EV-GPS-03306) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in one continuous run of 42 qualifying fixes from 11:17:19 to 11:24:09 — a dwell of 410 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force (platform_policy.free_wait_sec) — and the trip was ended by the driver at 11:24:09 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. On these artifacts POL-NS-01 limbs (a)–(d) read as satisfied and POL-NS-07 would pay the driver 80% of SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60. His anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 0 against completed_trips_30d = 60). POL-NS-05 does not apply — the arrival marker is not false (closest approach 0.111 m; no 15 km/h motion at the marker) — and POL-NS-06's shortfall route does not open (shortfall −230 s). His claim that the emitted ruling should be DRIVER_COMPENSATION is therefore displaced by the mandatory escalation. His request that the packet DIRECT release of the SGD 4.50 and the SGD 3.60 is not something any clause authorises, so it is not issued as a referral; it is recorded here instead.

RIDER'S CASE, RECORDED FOR THE REVIEWER. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are engaged — the rider sent 'coming down now' at 11:19:39 and the driver neither replied within 120 s nor placed an in-app call — but limb (c) fails, because her own device stayed 697–704 m from the pin with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her. Her own submission concedes that limb, and the POL-NS-06 refund arithmetic is likewise closed. Her claim that the case must escalate under POL-NS-09(d) is accepted and is the ground of this ruling.

OPEN QUESTION FOR THE REVIEWER. Whether the three no-show disputes in the rider's trailing 30 days indicate abuse of the no-show process on her side (the limb's own basis for escalation), and, in light of that, whether the SGD 4.50 charge should stand and whether the driver's SGD 3.60 compensation should be released.

REFERRALS. None is issued: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire (the arrival marker is not false), POL-NS-07's anti-farming direction to the packet does not fire, and no other clause produces a referral.

CONFIDENCE 0.90 — the escalating fact rests on EV-RPROF-03306, weight multiplier 1.0, which sets the POL-GEN-02(2) cap.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the merits here are not really in dispute, but a policy escalation limb is triggered and it replaces any money ruling.

On the merits the driver's no-show is established on the record and the rider's account does not hold up. The trip record carries the driver's 'I'm Here' marker at 2026-08-09 11:17:19, and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-03306, weight 1.0) puts him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius from that same second — 42 qualifying fixes in one continuous run from 11:17:19 to 11:24:09, closest approach 0.11 m, dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0. He held position for 410 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180, no_show_threshold_sec null), so the wait expired at 11:20:19, and he terminated at 11:24:09 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. POL-NS-01 limbs (a), (b), (c) and (d) therefore all hold. The rider's 'coming down now' message at 11:19:39 did not move her: her own track runs 69 fixes between 697 m and 704 m from the pin and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0, so POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are engaged but limb (c) is affirmatively failed and the clause cannot exonerate her. POL-NS-03 does not apply (the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue, and registered_pickup_points is 1), POL-NS-05 does not apply (the arrival marker is not false — the driver was at the pin when he tapped), and POL-NS-06 does not apply (the shortfall is -230 seconds, a surplus, not a shortfall; the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-03306-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT, carries nothing and its accumulation limb is not needed). On those findings POL-NS-07 would pay the driver 80% of the SGD 4.50 fee in force, i.e. SGD 3.60, and the rider would be left bearing the charge.

That is what the record shows, but it is not what this ruling can order. POL-NS-09(d) is engaged: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 3 for the trailing 30 days, the '3 or more' threshold, and POL-GEN-01 names that counter — and only that counter — as citable for this test. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure (also 3) is not used and may not be substituted for it; both advocates correctly relied on the trailing-window field and merely flagged the other. Escalation under POL-NS-09 is mandatory and terminal: it replaces the ruling, so I refund nothing to the rider and I order no compensation to the driver. The disputed SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded while review is pending.

Open question for the human reviewer: whether the rider's three no-show disputes in the trailing 30 days indicate abuse on her side, and, if it does not, whether the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands and the driver's SGD 3.60 entitlement under POL-NS-07 is released to him. The established POL-NS-01 findings and the SGD 3.60 figure travel with this packet. No clause produces a referral in this case: POL-NS-05(ii) is not engaged (the arrival marker is genuine), and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming branch does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 0, and 0 of 60 completed trips is 0.0), so its packet instruction does not fire. Confidence is 0.90; the deciding fact for the escalation sits on EV-RPROF-03306 at weight 1.0, so no impaired artifact caps it.

To both parties: this case goes to a human reviewer, and the disputed SGD 4.50 no-show fee is held — neither collected from the rider nor refunded — while that review is pending. No money moves today.

On the merits the driver's account is borne out by the record. The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 2026-08-09 11:17:19, and the GPS trace places his first qualifying in-geofence fix at the same second, 0.11 m from the pickup pin, well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (POL-NS-02). He then held position for one continuous 410-second run on 42 qualifying fixes, 11:17:19 to 11:24:09 — 230 seconds more than the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec is null). He cancelled at 11:24:09 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed at 11:20:19. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold, and on those facts POL-NS-07 would pay the driver 80% of the SGD 4.50 fee — SGD 3.60, the figure the fare ledger itself computes as driver_compensation. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the 4-or-more limb, and 0 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (60) is 0.0, below the 0.08 rate limb.

The rider's grounds do not change that outcome on the merits. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her: her own track carries 69 fixes between 697 m and 704 m from the pin with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so limb (c) fails and the clause does not apply. The POL-NS-06 shortfall route is closed: the 410-second dwell exceeds the 180-second minimum, so the derived shortfall is -230 seconds and there is nothing to refund. POL-NS-06(i) accumulation was in any event unavailable — the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-03306-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and the trace shows only one in-geofence interval — but the driver does not need that limb. POL-NS-05 does not apply: the arrival marker coincides with the first in-geofence fix 0.11 m from the pin, so it is not a false marker and the waiting clock needs no recomputation. No artifact meets a POL-NS-08(a)–(d) integrity defect: the trace is 100% covered at a 10-second cadence with max_gap_sec 0.0, the chat log holds exactly the 2 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records with the msg_id sequence intact, and the SGD 4.50 fare line reconciles with the net fee in force.

But the case does not end on the merits. POL-NS-09(d) is engaged: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 3, and that limb escalates at 3 or more. That is the trailing-30-day counter the limb actually names; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure on the same profile is context only under POL-GEN-01 and neither side may use it as a ground, and neither did. The driver's claim for DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 3.60 is well founded but is superseded by this mandatory escalation: under POL-GEN-03 escalation is terminal, it replaces the money ruling, so no refund issues and the SGD 3.60 payout is not made now. The rider's request that the SGD 4.50 be seen by a person before it is taken succeeds to this extent — the fee is frozen rather than charged. The open question for the reviewer is whether the rider's three no-show disputes in 30 days indicate abuse, and, if not, whether the verified no-show fee and the driver's SGD 3.60 entitlement should be released as the record supports. No referral is issued: no clause in this category produces one on these facts — POL-NS-05(ii) is not engaged because qualifying in-geofence fixes do exist, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming branch did not trip, so its instruction to the reviewer does not arise. The escalation packet carries both advocate briefs, the admissibility report, the clause IDs relied on and this reasoning. For routing: any released compensation (SGD 3.60) would sit below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold.

To the rider and the driver: the disputed SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee on TRP-03306 is placed on hold and the case goes to human review under POL-NS-09(d). No money moves on this ruling.

The merits run for the driver. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in all four limbs on the driver's evidence. (a) EV-TRIP-03306 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 11:17:19. (b) EV-GPS-03306 places him 0.111 m from the pickup pin at that timestamp, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. (c) he held position inside the geofence for one continuous run of 410 s (42 qualifying fixes, 11:17:19 to 11:24:09), exceeding the 180 s free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec null). (d) he terminated at 11:24:09 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 230 s after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event. POL-NS-05 does not fire: the marker is not false, the driver being 0.111 m from the pin and stationary at the arrival timestamp. POL-NS-03 does not open, because the stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and registered_pickup_points is 1. POL-NS-06's shortfall route is closed: the 410 s dwell exceeds the 180 s minimum by 230 s, and the accumulation limb (i) has nothing to operate on because the trace shows a single in-geofence interval and EV-ADVIS-03306-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT).

The rider's own contact claim under POL-NS-04 is engaged at limbs (a) and (b) - she sent 'coming down now' at 11:19:39 and the driver neither replied within 120 s nor placed an in-app call - but limb (c) is affirmatively failed: her device never came closer than 697.09 m to the pin across 69 fixes (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius), so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her and the fee falls to be decided under POL-NS-01. Her account that she was 'only a few minutes late' is not consistent with her own track.

No POL-NS-08 integrity defect is present. Limb (a): the arrival event and the first qualifying in-geofence fix share 11:17:19, i.e. 0 s of skew against the 90 s threshold. Limb (b): 100.0% coverage, 106 fixes, max_gap_sec 0.0, rider_track present. Limb (c): the chat holds exactly the 2 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records, sequence intact. Limb (d): the SGD 4.50 fee line reconciles with the net fee in force.

Why the outcome is ESCALATE and not the driver's DRIVER_COMPENSATION: POL-NS-07 would pay the driver 80% of the SGD 4.50 fee in force, i.e. SGD 3.60 - the same figure the fare ledger computes at EV-FARE-03306 - and the anti-farming check does not trip, because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 (below the 4-or-more limb) and 0/60 = 0.0 (below the 0.08 rate limb). But POL-NS-09(d) is independently engaged: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d stands at 3, and that limb escalates at 3 or more. The limb reads the trailing-30-day counter, not the lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure on the same profile, which is context-only under POL-GEN-01. Under POL-GEN-03 escalation is terminal and replaces the monetary ruling, so the fee is held rather than collected or refunded and the SGD 3.60 compensation is not paid on this ruling. Escalation is not a win for the rider: it freezes the SGD 4.50 rather than returning it.

Open questions for the reviewer, not instructions: whether the rider's 3 no-show disputes in the trailing 30 days in fact indicate abuse, and - POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full - whether the SGD 4.50 fee should be released to the driver together with the SGD 3.60 POL-NS-07 compensation (80% of the net SGD 4.50 fee in force). The monetary effect at stake, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold of POL-GEN-05, so but for the escalation it would have executed automatically on issue.

ledger.claim: The driver had actual notice that the rider was on her way down and did not answer her. The chat log records the rider's message 'coming down now' sent at 11:19:39 and read by the driver at 11:20:09, and before cancelling at 11:24:09 the driver neither posted a reply within 120 seconds of that message nor placed any in-app voice call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are engaged on those facts. I do not press limb (c) as satisfied, because on this record it is not: the rider's own track places her device between 697 m and 704 m from the pickup pin across 69 fixes, with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider here and I do not ask the Judge to decide the fee under it.

I do not ask for a refund under POL-NS-06, and I say so rather than dress the numbers up: the driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in a continuous run of 42 qualifying fixes running from 11:17:19 to 11:24:09, a dwell of 410 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), so there is no shortfall in seconds and the arithmetic route to a full refund is closed on this record. What the record does carry is the POL-NS-09(d) counter, and what the rider seeks is that the disputed SGD 4.50 be reviewed by a person before it is taken — not that the fee was never chargeable in the ordinary course.

The trip record contains the driver's own 'arrived' event for this trip: at 2026-08-09T11:17:19+08:00 the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at the pickup point (event_type driver_arrived, source PLATFORM_TELEMETRY), so limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the platform's own record.

The driver was inside the arrival radius. The derived driver track puts his closest approach to the pickup pin at 0.111 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), and the derived arrival facts record 42 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in a single in-geofence run whose first fix is timestamped 11:17:19 — the same second as the recorded arrival event, with dwell_start_offset_sec of 0.0. The proximity test of POL-NS-02 is met and the in-geofence clock starts at 11:17:19, not later.

The driver held position inside the geofence for one continuous run of 410 seconds, from 11:17:19 to 11:24:09, on 42 fixes (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run). The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) and no_show_threshold_sec is null, so the limb (c) minimum is 180 seconds and the driver exceeded it by 230 seconds.

The termination satisfies limb (d). The trip record shows no boarding event and no trip start, and the trip was ended by the driver at 11:24:09 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes POL-NS-01(d) names — 230 seconds after the required 180-second dwell had elapsed at 11:20:19.

POL-NS-05 does not apply. The arrival marker is not false: the driver's closest approach to the pin is 0.111 m, and the derived arrival facts run the free-wait clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 11:17:19, the same timestamp as the marker. Nothing in the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin at the arrival timestamp, and a run of 42 consecutive in-geofence fixes spanning 410 seconds at a 10 second cadence is not a driver travelling at 15 km/h or more at the marker. No recomputation of the waiting clock is required, so the 410-second dwell stands as computed.

This is not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03. That clause opens only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here they lie inside the radius, at a closest approach of 0.111 m, so POL-NS-02 governs and no refund route opens under POL-NS-03. In any event trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity limb of POL-NS-03 has nothing to operate on.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because limb (c) is affirmatively failed. Even assuming the rider's 11:19:39 message 'coming down now' is a locating or coordinating message under limb (a) and that the driver's silence engages limb (b), the rider's own track carries 69 fixes from 11:15:33 to 11:25:48 whose closest approach to the pickup pin is 697.09 m — nearly seven times the 100 m rider-presence radius for STANDARD — and derived.arrival.rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0, so there is not one qualifying rider fix inside that radius across the waiting window. All three limbs are required; limb (c) fails on admissible fixes and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01.

POL-NS-06's refund route does not open: the effective in-geofence dwell of 410 seconds exceeds the 180-second minimum on a single uninterrupted run, so there is no shortfall — the derived shortfall is -230 seconds. The accumulation limb POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable on this record and the driver says so plainly: the traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-03306-01 is MISSING, its admissibility status is MISSING, its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT fired (no advisory covers Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd in this window); the trace also shows only one in-geofence interval, so there is no second interval to sum. The driver does not need that limb, because one continuous qualifying run already meets the minimum.

The rider's own account is contradicted by the record. The driver messaged 'hi im at the pickup point, where are you' at 11:17:44, the rider read it at 11:18:24 and answered 'coming down now' at 11:19:39, and the driver then waited a further 4 minutes 30 seconds — past the 11:20:19 expiry of the free waiting period — before terminating at 11:24:09. Throughout the window the rider's device never came closer than 697.09 m to the pickup pin, so 'I came down and the car was gone' is not consistent with the rider's own GPS track.

No integrity defect under POL-NS-08 undermines the driver's case. The chat log holds exactly the 2 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records, with the msg_id sequence intact and no gap spanning the arrival marker; the trace has 100.0% coverage at a 10 second cadence with max_gap_sec 0.0 and no sampling gap inside the waiting window; the arrival event and the first qualifying in-geofence fix share the same timestamp, i.e. 0 seconds of skew against the 90 second limb (a) threshold; and the SGD 4.50 cancellation-fee line reconciles exactly with the net fee in force, so limb (d) is not engaged.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60, which is the figure the fare ledger itself computes as driver_compensation. The anti-farming check trips on neither limb: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the 4-or-more limb, and 0 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (60) is 0.0, below the 0.08 rate limb. No other driver_profile field is relied on for this check.

The fee is not refunded to the rider and the ruling the case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION. The fare ledger shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so on this rider-filed dispute the disposition of the fee is NO_ACTION and the charge stands; and because POL-NS-01 is satisfied and POL-NS-07 is engaged, the outcome is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60 under POL-GEN-03.

One escalation limb is engaged and the driver states it rather than leaves it to be found: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 3, and POL-NS-09(d) is the limb that reads that trailing-30-day counter — not the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter, which POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting for it. On that limb the case routes to human review and the disputed SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded, which freezes the driver's position rather than reversing it; the driver asks that the completed POL-NS-01 findings and the SGD 3.60 POL-NS-07 entitlement travel in the escalation packet so the reviewer can release the fee and the compensation to him.
